heard: From Babylon we came back home Walking down the dusty road Zerubbabel led the way We carried light to break the night Sons of Frebaran and sons of Haggabah Names written in the holy book Sons of Akum, walking through, restoring what was torn and lost Temple servants with no name, sons of Zeeha and Hasufa Serving God in humble way, rebuilding faith that stayed with us Sons of Frebora and sons of Agaba
